caption:
Mr Turtle started a courier job and now drives all day. Stepping out of the van to lift a box, his lower back feels stiff.

Straight after a long sit, the body can feel less warmed up. Clinical Pilates builds hip and trunk strength and control, which can help with the sit-then-lift rhythm of driving work.

Hybi's routine: sit with your hips right back in the seat, do 5 gentle back bends each time you get out, hold boxes close, and do bridges at home (10 × 2 sets).

Tingling down a leg, a weak leg or pain that isn't easing after two weeks are worth an assessment first. Clinical Pilates at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio 🚚

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
